title: Vector relevance observability: per-endpoint pulse, traces, and cost attribution
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: customers and SREs currently lack a compact, correlated view that ties ranking quality signals (similarity scores, rerank deltas) to latency spikes and token-level cost. This makes it slow to diagnose regressions or cost anomalies for specific endpoints.

Goal: provide a lightweight per-endpoint "pulse" dashboard and linked traces that surface: summary quality metrics (average similarity, top-k delta, NDCG sample), latency distribution (p50/p95/p99 for embedding + scorer), token & GPU cost breakdown per request, and deterministic links from anomalous points to full traces and sample payloads. Deliverables should enable faster RCA, automated alerts for SLO breach or quality regressions, and cost chargeback visibility by endpoint and model variant.
acceptance_criteria: A per-endpoint dashboard exists in Console that shows: request count, p50/p95/p99 latency for embed and rerank stages, average similarity score, top-k delta histogram, 24h cost, and error rate.
Each anomalous chart point links to a trace or trace sampling view with full request/response payload redaction per privacy policy.
Cost attribution is broken down to token-level (embedding vs rerank compute) and surfaced as a per-endpoint time series for the last 30 days.
Alerting rules implemented: latency-P95 > target for 5min, rerank-quality-drop > 10% (baseline window) and cost-anomaly alert using z-score for daily spend deviation.
Benchmarks showing end-to-end dashboard query latency < 2s for 30d retention queries and no more than 6% extra ingestion cost.
Runbook and playbook docs added and linked from dashboard with triage steps and rollback guidance.
tasks: Define telemetry keys and tags for endpoint, model_variant, shard, and batch_id (SLA + cost mapping)
Add structured events for similarity scores and rerank deltas to the request trace payload (redacted fields for PII)
Extend ingestion pipeline to compute token-level cost attribution and store as a metric series keyed by endpoint+model_variant
Build Console dashboard widgets: overview card, latency heatmap, quality histogram, cost waterfall, top offender table
Add links from dashboard points to distributed trace storage (include sampling policy for high-volume endpoints)
Create and validate alerting rules in PagerDuty/Alertmanager and add example thresholds per customer tier
Author playbook: how to investigate a quality regression (queries to run, sample extraction, suggested mitigations)
QA: synthetic traffic across 3 endpoint types (low-latency, high-throughput, heavy-embedding) to validate metrics and cost attribution
alerting_rules: RankingLatencyP95: trigger if embed+rerank p95 > SLA_P95 for 5m
QualityDrop: trigger if top-k mean delta decreases by >10% vs baseline 24h window
CostSpike: trigger if endpoint daily spend z-score > 3
tracing_plan: Emit lightweight span for 'embedding.encode' and 'reranker.score' with tags: endpoint, model_variant, batch_size, shard_id
Attach minimal sample payload (first 2 tokens / vector hex digest) and pointer to full redacted payload stored in object storage
Implement dynamic sampling: 0.5% baseline, 100% sampling on alerts for the next 15m
Add deterministic correlation id to join dashboard point -> trace -> billing record
telemetry_schema_changes: new metric: ranking.top_k_delta (gauge) tagged by endpoint, model_variant
new metric: ranking.similarity_avg (gauge) tagged by endpoint, model_variant
new metric: cost.token_embedding and cost.token_rerank (counters) tagged by endpoint
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable telemetry for 5 internal endpoints, validate dashboards and sampling (1 week)
Phase 2 (beta): open to 25 customers as opt-in, compare cost delta and feedback (2 weeks)
Phase 3 (GA): onboard all endpoints with default 0.5% sampling and alerting enabled for P1 customers
